description: prConcurrentLimit is raised above config:recommended's default of 10.
osvVulnerabilityAlerts only covers *direct* dependencies, so a vulnerable
transitive package (e.g. starlette via fastapi) can only be fixed by the
lockFileMaintenance refresh below. At the default limit, a 10-PR backlog
saturates the quota and starves that refresh -- which is exactly how two
High-severity transitive CVEs sat unfixed while the queue stayed red.

packageRules.description: Group dev-tooling (PEP 735 dev group) into one PR

description: Auto-merge lockfile-maintenance refreshes once CI is green.
prPriority puts this ahead of routine version bumps in the queue: it is
the only update type that can remediate a transitive dependency, so it
must never be the PR that gets rate-limited away.
